name: 王紳
objective:
本課程包含：1. 傳輸線理論  2. 集總元件與阻抗匹配   3. 微波網路分析  4. 射頻耦合器
學生能從這門課學習到射頻被動元件的分析、設計。
schedule:
Week 1-4  Transmission Line Theory & Case Study 
Week 5-7  Impedance Matching & Case Study
Week 8     業師教學
Week 9    Midterm Report
Week 10-13  Microwave Network Analysis & Case Study
Week 14	業師教學
Week 15-17	Power Dividers and Couplers & Case Study
Week 18   Final
materials:
1. 自編講義
2. D.M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering,3rd. Ed. John Wiley & Sons, 2005.
